replay.how: tools/device/fnaf1-winner.mjs materializes the whole tree of sourcesAtCommit from git, checks every file against the commit's blob ids and every pinned file against sources, and runs that tree's fnaf1-custom-run.sh with this command's arguments (only the label changes) under the checkout's serial lease. Without --live it is the dry run. The tree's own runner refuses this winner's night while its route differs from these pins.
